capabilities: Export the current note as standalone HTML
Merge a folder's notes into one HTML book with chapters
Embed local vault attachments as Base64 data
Preview the exported note in a side panel
Customize reader theme, cover, direction, and typography
disambiguation: Not a publishing or website generator; it produces one local .html reader file per note or per folder, with no hosting or sync features.
extras: Community plugin store listing is described as pending ('Once published'), so installation is currently manual via GitHub release files. Large embedded media can greatly increase output HTML size, and remote links still need internet. Some browser-opening behavior is desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian notes are Markdown files that need Obsidian to read comfortably, and there is no built-in way to produce a self-contained HTML document for offline reading or sharing.
summary: Exporter that turns a single note or a whole folder into one standalone HTML reader with embedded attachments and Persian/English support.
